name: Cube of Force

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Press a face
powers.text: Magic action: press a face (1 to 5 charges) to raise a 15-ft cube of force around you that keeps out gas, objects, living things, spells, or everything; face 6 ends it.

summary: Raise a cube of force around yourself that keeps out gases, objects, creatures, spells, or all of them.
text: A cube roughly an inch on each side, with a different symbol on each face that can be pushed. It holds 10 charges and recovers 1d6 of them each dawn. Pressing a face is a Magic action that costs charges according to the face; if the cube lacks enough, nothing happens. Otherwise an invisible wall of force forms a cube 15 feet on each side, centered on you and moving with you. It lasts 1 minute, or until you press the sixth face (a Magic action), or until the charges run out. Face 1 (1 charge): blocks gases, wind and fog. Face 2 (2 charges): blocks nonliving matter, though you may let walls, floors and ceilings pass. Face 3 (3 charges): blocks living matter. Face 4 (4 charges): blocks spell effects. Face 5 (5 charges): blocks everything, though you may let walls, floors and ceilings pass. Face 6 (0 charges): shuts the barrier off. Some spells that target the barrier, and some effects of spells or magic items that touch it, drain charges from the cube.
